Ruling (Decisions, owner rulings, AC5): cite 0157; a job-lane Unavailable takes today's job-ask path with the offline reason on the decision and the one notice sent to the job conversation before the terminal decision (IPC) / before the scheduled cancel return at inline :410; pinned by the job-lane leaf.
